headline: Spain’s Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo Takes Over Transport Portfolio
summary: Spain's economy minister, Carlos Cuerpo, assumed control of the transport ministry following the resignation of Óscar Puente over the Urda train crash.
why: Ministerial changes in major European economies can alter national infrastructure spending priorities, regulatory frameworks, and transport sector policy execution.

impacts.name: Spain
impacts.why: Consolidation of economy and transport portfolios under Carlos Cuerpo unifies fiscal and infrastructure management.
